execution.raw_text:
{
  "sql": "SELECT
    m.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
    m.pref_name AS pref_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles,
    m.max_phase AS max_phase,
    dm.mechanism_of_action AS mechanism_of_action,
    dm.action_type AS action_type,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
    td.pref_name AS target_name
FROM molecule_dictionary m
JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON m.molregno = dm.molregno
JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON m.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE m.max_phase = 4
  AND dm.action_type = 'BLOCKER'
ORDER BY
    m.chembl_id,
    m.pref_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    m.max_phase,
    dm.mechanism_of_action,
    dm.action_type,
    td.chembl_id,
    td.pref_name;"
}
